strings.(정확히 언제인지 알 수 없는 시간의 틈, 그 사이.): (Somewhere between the cracks of time, at a moment impossible to place precisely.)
Liz, put that book down before we talk.
strings.저번에 정신 놓고 쉬다가 허공해에서 몰려드는 나쁜 마력을 그대로 받았지?: Last time you zoned out while resting, you absorbed the harmful magic pouring in from the Sea of Emptiness, remember?
strings.너처럼 마력에 민감한 사서는 언제나 정신 바짝 차리고 있어야 해. 안 그: A librarian as sensitive to magic as you must stay alert. Otherwise, harmful energy will consume you.
Sorry. I didn't do it on purpose.
strings.그래서 너한테는 이번 일이 힘들 거야. 놀이터에 들어가면 최악의 상황이: That's why this will be difficult for you. If you enter the playground, the worst could happen.
I've already asked for help, so don't worry too much.
I just remembered the saying about how a tiger comes when you... roar.
Was that a common saying in Elias? Roar.
strings.이렇게 모험가님께서 오신 걸 보니 헤프링이 제대로 편지를 전달해 준 모양: Since you're here, Hefring must have delivered the letter properly. Roar.
I was surprised when Hefring suddenly appeared with a letter in its mouth.
strings.펠이 놀이터까지 날아온 헤프링을 스카우트했죠. \"헤프링 너, 소질이 있: Pel recruited Hefring when it flew to the playground. He said, 'Hefring, you seem to have talent. Why not work with us?'
We provide three meals a day, regular snacks, and pet insurance.
strings.오, 좋네요. 그런데 무슨 일로 부르셨어요?: Oh, that's nice. Why did you call me?
If you mean the old spirit Hermit, whom the Belpha librarians call their inspiration, he's right here...
strings.그 영감님 말고요. \"영감\"요. 마력을 가진 이들에게는 영혼적인 감각: Not that old fellow. 'Inspiration.' To those with magic, it's a spiritual sense. Usually, it means a flash of a clever idea or stimulus when creating something.
strings.아…. 그 \"영감\"을 찾는데, 제가 도움이 될까요?: Oh... Can I help you find that kind of inspiration?
Of course. You've already prevented the world's destruction several times.
strings.펠, %s 님께 [영감의 놀이터]에 대해 설명해 드려. 난 여기 들어오려: Pel, explain the [Playground of Inspiration] to %s. I'll stop the toy cars and planes trying to get in here.
strings.영감의 놀이터? 도서관에 있는 놀이터예요?: The Playground of Inspiration? A playground inside the library?
strings.네, 맞아요. 지식의 신 레다께서는 아이들을 무척 사랑하셔서 아이들에게: That's right. Leda, god of knowledge, loved children dearly and wanted to teach them many things.
strings.그래서 도서관을 설립할 때 아이들을 위한 공간을 많이 만들었죠. 그중 하: So when the library was founded, many spaces were made for children. The playground is one of them.
strings.장난감과 놀이기구가 많아서 아이들이 무척 좋아하죠. 이곳에서 허공해를 바: It's full of toys and play equipment, so children love it. Adults visit too, saying the view of the Sea of Emptiness clears their minds.
strings.특히 작가나 예술가들이 많은 영감을 얻는다면서, 언제부턴가 [영감의 놀이: Writers and artists especially said they found great inspiration there. Eventually, it became known as the [Playground of Inspiration].
strings.그런데 지금은 왜 이렇게 시끄럽죠?: But why is it so noisy now?
strings.누군가의 거대한 영감이 놀이터에 그대로 남아서 장난감과 놀이기구들에 깃들: Someone's enormous inspiration remained in the playground and inhabited the toys and equipment.
It also created something like a huge golem, which is a real headache. Sigh...
strings.그것들이 안으로 들어오면 모조리 엉망이 될 거예요. 안 그래도 매일 책: If those things get inside, they'll wreck everything. Keeping the books organized every day is already exhausting!!
No, more importantly, if they mix with the knowledge inside, something terrible...
strings.세계를 유지하는 지식의 흐름이 멈추고 오염돼요. 사람들이 잘못된 것들을: The flow of knowledge that sustains the world will stop and become contaminated. People will believe false things are true.
But the librarians are holding them back as best they can, so we're all right for now.
strings.아앗, 모험가님. 바로 가면 영감이 폭주해요. 그래서 영감의 주인을 알고: Wait, adventurer! If you go directly, the inspiration will run wild. We need to identify its owner and prepare properly.
strings.펠, 혹시 영감의 주인에 관해 아는 것이 있나요?: Pel, do you know anything about its owner?
strings.유명 작가 클라라 님이에요. 얼마 전에 도서관에서 사인회를 열었는데, 끝: The famous author Clara. She held a book signing at the library recently, and afterward the playground became like this. But I don't know where she is now.
I've met her in Lifthrasir. I'll ask Director Lif.
It's nothing. I'll be back as soon as I can.
Phew. Those Tire Men and mini cars are relentless. I can't understand what they're saying either.
strings.며칠은 버틸 수 있을 거야. 그런데 모험가님은?: We should hold out for a few days. Where's the adventurer?
Went to see the author Clara.
strings.빨리 방법을 찾았으면 좋겠는데…. 어, 이 책 뭐야? 클라라 작가님 사인: I hope they find a way quickly... Huh, what's this book? A signed copy by Clara?
Yes, her new book. Volume one of The Regressed Queen of a Fallen Kingdom Doesn't Hide That She's a Witch. You've read it, right?
strings.이거 그때 사인회 참가자들에게 다 나눠 줬는데…. 누가 두고 갔나? 줘: They gave these to everyone at the signing... Did someone leave it behind? Give it here. I'll find the owner.
strings.「To. 카이나 던 실바리아. 행복하세요.」: 「To Kaina Dawn Silvaria. Wishing you happiness.」
strings.마을에 일이 있어서 고민을 좀 하고 있었죠. 아, 클라라 알죠?: Thinking about a village matter. Oh, you know Clara, right?
strings.클라라가 벨파 도서관에서 신간 출간 기념 사인회를 했거든요. 잘 끝난 줄: Clara held a signing for her new book at Belpha Library. I thought it went well, but she seemed strangely listless.
strings.그래서 물어보니까 놀이터에 잠깐 앉아서 다음 작품 구상을 하고 있었는데,: When I asked, she said she was sitting in the playground thinking about her next book. The children thought she'd fainted and shook her awake.
She thought she'd closed her eyes for a moment... But several hours had passed. So she left the library and returned to the village...
strings.그 후로 다음 작품 구상했던 것들이 하나도 안 떠오른대요. 심지어 집필: Since then, she can't remember any of the ideas for her next work. She can't even write the next part of her current manuscript.
Even if she forces herself to sit and write, her hand won't move.
strings.혹시 몰라서 클라라 주위에 심술궂은 정령들이 있나 살펴봤지만, 그것도 아: I checked whether any mischievous spirits were around her, just in case, but that wasn't it...
strings.(리프에게 벨파 도서관의 상황을 간단하게 이야기한다.): (You briefly explain the situation at Belpha Library to Lif.)
Sigh. So that's what happened. And Clara doesn't even know.
strings.제가 가서 만나 봐도 괜찮겠죠?: Would it be all right if I went to see her?
strings.수정달 숲으로 산책 나갔어요. 항상 같은 자리에 있으니까 금방 찾을 수: She went for a walk in the Crystal Moon Forest. She's always in the same spot, so you'll find her easily.
I'll talk with her and look for a solution.
Thank you, %s. Please look after our Clara.
strings.평소라면 리프트라시르 관련으로 뭘 자꾸 권유하실 텐데, 오늘은 안 그러시: Normally, you'd keep recommending something related to Lifthrasir, but not today.
Hehe. I'm not some unscrupulous director who talks about nothing else.
strings.바쁠 텐데 빨리 클라라에게 가 보세요. 리프트라시르 홍보 대사 임명장은: You must be busy, so hurry to Clara. I'll give you your appointment as Lifthrasir's goodwill ambassador next time.
I'll tell you if I ever feel like becoming an ambassador. Goodbye for now.
strings.도서관장님께서 자리에 안 계신가? 그 정도는 단번에 제압하실 수 있을 텐: Is the library director away? This much should be easy to subdue...
strings.며칠째 한 줄도 못 썼어. 이런 적은 한 번도 없었는데…. 바보가 된 기: I haven't written a single line in days. This has never happened before... I feel like an idiot.
strings.고블린이 고블고블 울고 있다. 코볼트가 코볼코볼…. 아아, 이런 걸 쓰려: The goblin goes gobble-gobble. The kobold goes kobble-kobble... Ah, that's not what I wanted to write...
I'm in the middle of something. Excuse me.
strings.클라라, 잠깐만요. 얼마 전에 벨파 도서관에 갔죠?: Clara, wait. You went to Belpha Library recently, right?
I did visit the Playground of Inspiration...
strings.(클라라에게 벨파 도서관의 상황을 이야기한다.): (You tell Clara about the situation at Belpha Library.)
My inspiration is rampaging there? That sounds strange...
strings.있다가도 없고, 없다가도 있는 게 영감이야. 뭔가가 떠오를 때 메모라도: Inspiration comes and goes. If you don't jot down an idea when it appears, it simply vanishes.
strings.표현하지 않으면 없는 것인데…. 그게 밖으로 나와서 그렇게 사건을 일으키: If you don't express it, it doesn't exist... So how could it come out and cause trouble? That's impossible.
Impossible or not, it really happened. If we don't deal with it properly...
strings.(클라라에게 펠이 이야기했던 최악의 경우를 설명한다.): (You explain the worst-case scenario Pel described.)
I have no magic. I can't even see spirits...
strings.(그때 클라라의 옆에 서 있는 나무에서 뭔가가 떨어진다.): (Just then, something falls from the tree beside Clara.)
strings.다니엘, 여기서 뭐 해요?: Daniel, what are you doing here?
strings.특종 냄새를 쫓다 보니 여기까지 오게 됐습니다무. 흠, 이 여성분께 냄새: I followed the scent of a scoop all the way here, squawk. Hmm, this woman has the scent.
strings.병아리 아니고 앵무새입니다무. 그리고 냄새란 게 그 냄새가 아닙니담, 클: I'm a parrot, not a chick, squawk. And that's not the kind of smell I mean, Clara.
Hehe, of course. Knowing famous people is part of a reporter's job.
strings.다 들었지…? 이거 기사로 쓸 거야?: You heard everything, didn't you...? Are you going to write an article?
strings.분명 특종이지만 저 다니엘, 관련 인물의 허락 없이는 기사를 쓰지 않습니: It's certainly a scoop, but I, Daniel, never write without permission from the people involved. Still, I've thought of a headline. Would you like to hear it?
strings.「유명 작가 도서관에서 폭주 즐겨, 충격!」: 「Shocking! Famous Author Enjoys Rampage in Library!」
How about this revised version? 「Bestselling Author Ruined by Lack of Inspiration.」
strings.아니, 누구한테 제목 만드는 법을 배웠길래 다 그래요?: Who taught you to write headlines like that?
strings.(다니엘이 가방에서 책 한 권을 꺼내 들어 보인다.): (Daniel takes a book from his bag and holds it up.)
Oh, Rosengarten Monthly... You'll really be ruined if you write articles like the ones in there.
strings.%s 님, 제발 도와주십쇼. 매일 흙 파먹을 수는 없습니다무!: %s, please help me. I can't keep eating dirt every day, squawk!
strings.데미갓 리디아 님께서 맛있는 것을 먹고 싶으면 제대로 된 기사 하나 써서: Lady Lydia, the demigod, said to bring her one proper article if I wanted something tasty to eat!!
strings.(다니엘이 파닥거리자 들고 있던 월간 로젠가르텐 사이에서 뭔가가 떨어진다: (As Daniel flaps, something falls from between the pages of Rosengarten Monthly.)
strings.오, 이게 여기 있을 줄이야. 이건 말입니담, 유령처럼 보이지 않는 것들: Oh, so that's where it was. This is sticky paper for catching invisible things like ghosts, squawk.
You said you've visited Rosengarten, %s, so you must have seen them. You know the Souls that look like plastic bags?
strings.걔네를 가만히 내버려두면 둥둥 떠다녀서 제가 이걸로 붙여서 모아 뒀습니담: If left alone, they float about, so I stuck them to this and gathered them up. It's especially precious because only I can use it...
Those are memories now... Ah, Rosengarten is gone...
strings.%s, 잠깐만. 조용. 혹시 저걸로 날뛰는 영감도 붙잡을 수 있을까?: %s, wait. Quiet. Could that catch my rampaging inspiration too?
strings.오, 좋은 생각이네요. 해 볼까요?: Oh, good idea. Shall we try?
strings.저기 병아리, 아니 앵무, 다니엘이라고 했지?: Hey, chick... I mean, parrot. Daniel, was it?
I'll help you write your article, so come report from the scene with us.
strings.가, 감사합니다. 앵무 기자 다니엘 가, 감격했습니다무!: Th-Thank you! Daniel the parrot reporter is d-deeply moved, squawk!
Oh, a scoop! The scent of a scoop never lies...
%s, let's go to the library and catch my inspiration with that sticky paper...
...That sounds a little odd, but let's try.
strings.그건 그렇고 신기하네요. 하급 마족이 조금이라도 나쁜 마음을 가지고 있다: Still, this is remarkable. If a lesser demon had even the slightest ill intent...
He'd have screamed in agony the moment he entered.
strings.반짝거리는 눈빛으로 도서관을 구경하고 있네. 특종을 찾는 앵무 기자라니,: Look at him admiring the library with sparkling eyes. A parrot reporter hunting a scoop. How cute.
Lady Lydia gave her permission too, so it should be fine.
If it isn't, I'll deal with him.
strings.저 정도면 한 방이지?: One blow should be enough, right?
I'd have to try to know...
strings.그, 그런 무서운 말씀을 그렇게 대놓고 하시면 어떡합니까무!!: H-How can you say such frightening things right in front of me, squawk?!
Don't panic. Just don't do anything bad.
For something from the Demon Realm, it doesn't seem to have harmful energy.
strings.앵무 집사들이 최저 시급도, 야근 수당도 받지 못하고 밤새워 열심히 만든: The parrot butlers worked all night making it without minimum wage or overtime pay, squawk!
When we're done reporting from the scene, I'll also give you an interview about my new book.
strings.알겠습니담! 잘 부탁드리겠습니다무!: Understood! Thank you very much, squawk!
I'm counting on you as our sticky parrot too.
strings.펠, 리즈. 놀이터로 가려면 어느 쪽으로 가야 하죠?: Pel, Liz. Which way is the playground?
strings.아래층 복도에서 쭉 앞으로 나가면 돼요. 어?: Straight down the corridor on the lower floor. Huh?
strings.작가님이 오셔서 그런지 놀이터에 있는 놀이기구랑 장난감들의 움직임이 활발: Perhaps because the author is here, the toys and playground equipment seem more active.
But Mr. Reporter, your stomach keeps rumbling.
I haven't eaten anything but dirt for days... Squawk...
strings.아, 그러면 내 음식을 좀 나눠 줄게요. 이거면 될까요?: Oh, then I'll share some of my food. Will this do?
strings.앵무새…. 아니, 앵무 기자 다니엘은 사람 음식을 먹는다…?: A parrot... No, Daniel the parrot reporter eats human food...?
I'd eat it if I had any! I really don't... Sob.
strings.%s 님. 여기 다니엘 기자님이 들고 있는 끈끈이 종이 있잖아요. 한 장: %s, about the sticky paper Daniel is holding. I didn't think one sheet would be enough, so I made several. Take them.
Then we'll go once Daniel finishes eating.
strings.후아아아, 잘 먹었습니다무! 이제 취재도 힘내서 할 수 있을 것 같습니다: Phewww! Thank you for the meal, squawk! Now I can give this report my all!
Let me see the sticky paper. If I do this...
strings.(클라라가 끈끈이 종이를 모아 다니엘의 몸 전체에 붙인다.): (Clara gathers the sheets and sticks them all over Daniel's body.)
strings.오! 특종이 기다립니다. 특종입니다무!: Oh! A scoop awaits. A scoop, squawk!
We have a hero with us in case anything happens, so we'll be fine.
Am I, Daniel, the hero? Or...
strings.용사 아냐? 위험한 일들을 여럿 해결했잖아. 그래서 그렇게 부른 것뿐이야: Aren't you a hero? You've resolved all sorts of dangerous situations. That's why I called you that.
Let's go. The hero beats down the rampaging inspiration, and the reporter catches it with sticky paper.
strings.뭐, 제가 호위하려고 했으니까 너무 걱정 마세요. 이제 들어갈 테니까 두: Well, I planned to protect you, so don't worry. We're going in now. Both of you, stay close behind me.
strings.그런데 말입니담, 관망이 무슨 뜻입니까? 우리 망했다는 겁니까무?: But what does 'observe' mean? Are we being served up as dinner, squawk?
It means I'll watch. No one's serving you up.
Observe, observe. I really thought we were done for.
So this is the Playground of Inspiration...
Oh, is this the Playground of Inspiration? There are so many toys and rides, squawk.
strings.여기서는 허공해가 잘 보이네요. 확 트인 풍경 덕분에 답답했던 속이 뻥: The Sea of Emptiness is clearly visible from here. That wide-open view makes me feel as though a weight has lifted.
strings.가끔 벨파 도서관에 오면 여기서 허공해를 바라보곤 해. 종종 괜찮은 소재: When I come to Belpha Library, I sometimes look out at the sea from here. It often gives me good ideas.
strings.으갸악…. 장난감 비행기, 장난감 말, 미니카, 미끄럼틀까지 오고 있습니: Squaaawk! Toy planes, toy horses, mini cars, even a slide are coming at us!!
strings.(클라라의 머리 위를 맴돌던 골판지 비행기가 멈춘다.): (The cardboard airplane circling above Clara's head stops.)
strings.(클라라의 말에 멈춰 있던 골판지 비행기가 일행을 지나쳐 놀이터 바깥으로: (At Clara's words, the still airplane tries to fly past the group and out of the playground.)
strings.(%s의 공격에 골판지 비행기가 구겨져 바닥으로 떨어진다.): (%s's attack crumples the cardboard airplane, sending it to the ground.)
Huh? The airplane made a squawking sound and dropped something.
strings.끈끈이에 붙여 봤습니다무! 이거 보이십니까무?!: I've caught it on the sticky paper, squawk! Can you see it now?
It looks like a sparkling marble... Let's see...
strings.…이거 확실히 내 영감 같아. 집필 중이던 원고에서 막혔던 부분이 떠올랐: ...This is definitely my inspiration. I remembered the part of my manuscript where I was stuck...
strings.무슨 내용입니까무?: What happens in the story, squawk?
The hero dies after being hit by a carriage whose driver fell asleep.
strings.그런데 여신이 나타나 아직 죽을 때가 아니라면서 다시 살 수 있는 기회를: But a goddess appears, says it isn't time to die yet, and offers another chance at life...
strings.눈을 떠 보니까 엄청난 힘을 가진 마족이 되어 있는 거야. 게다가 공주를: When the hero opens their eyes, they've become an immensely powerful demon. And they're on the way to the Demon Realm after kidnapping a princess.
strings.자고로 공주 납치 같은 건 마왕이 하는 거 아닙니까무?: Isn't kidnapping princesses usually the Demon King's job, squawk?
strings.무, 무!! 작가님, 빨리 다음, 다음을!! 무, 무!!: S-Squawk!! Author, hurry! What happens next? Next?!
strings.…영감이 사라져서 뒷부분이 떠오르지 않아…. 놀이터 안에 있는 영감을 더: ...My inspiration is gone, so I can't remember the rest... We need to find more of it in the playground.
strings.그 영감들, 제가 다 찾아오겠습니다. 아니, 온몸에 잔뜩 붙여 오겠습니다: I'll find every bit of that inspiration. No, I'll stick it all over my body, squawk!
So I'll defeat them, and Daniel can bring it back.
strings.%s, 기분이 이상해. 속이 울렁거려…. 이제 작은 영감 하나 찾은 것뿐: %s, I feel strange. My stomach is turning... We've only found one little piece of inspiration...
strings.저번처럼 갑자기 기절하는 건 아니겠죠?: You won't suddenly faint like last time, will you?
strings.%s 님, 빨리 영감이 기다립니담! 빨리 끝내고 와야 합니다무!: %s, hurry! Inspiration awaits! We need to finish quickly, squawk!
strings.다니엘, 혼자 가면 위험해요. 같이 가요!: Daniel, it's dangerous to go alone. Let's stay together!
Pant, pant. With so many inspiration marbles stuck to me, I'm getting heavy...
Daniel, hold on a little longer.
For the sake of hearing the rest of the author's story...
strings.특종 인터뷰가 먼저 아닌가요?: Shouldn't the exclusive interview come first?
strings.아차! 특종, 특종이 먼저입니다무!: Oh, right! The scoop comes first, squawk!
strings.%s 님, 어디서 귀여운 척이십니까무?: %s, why are you trying to sound cute?
I wasn't trying to be cute. There was a strange sound...
strings.(이상한 소리와 함께 다니엘과 %s 앞에 거대한 그림자가 드리운다.): (With that strange sound, a huge shadow falls before Daniel and %s.)
strings.흐갸악, %s 님 덕분에 살았습니담. 지금 날아온 게 뭡니까무? 타이어…: Squaaawk! You saved me, %s. What just flew at us? A tire...?
strings.(귀여운 괴성과 함께 온몸이 타이어로 된 괴물이 모습을 드러낸다.): (With a cute cry, a monster made entirely of tires appears.)
It calls itself the Inspired Tire Man, squawk! Let me listen.
strings.이 몸은 폐타이어라는 이유만으로 구석에서 할 일 없이 놀고 있었다무! 하: 'Because I was a used tire, I sat in a corner with nothing to do! But I obtained tremendous inspiration and magic, and awakened!'
strings.이제 놀이터를 정복하고 타이어 왕국을 세울 것이다무! 그리고 아이들과 함: 'Now I will conquer the playground and found a tire kingdom! And play with the children!'
It doesn't seem to be lying.
strings.그런데 다니엘, 타이어맨 말을 어떻게 알아듣는 거예요?: But Daniel, how do you understand Tire Man?
strings.마계에서 백수일 때 취업 대비로 몬스터언어능력평가(MLPT, Monste: When I was unemployed in the Demon Realm, I earned level two on the Monster-Language Proficiency Test, the MLPT, to prepare for job hunting.
strings.2급이면 취재에도 꽤 도움이 됩니담. 마계에는 말이 안 통하는 양반들이: Level two is quite useful for reporting too. There are many people in the Demon Realm you can't communicate with...
strings.(대체 마계는 어떤 곳이지…?): (What kind of place is the Demon Realm...?)
strings.더 위협적으로 변한 것 같은데…. 다니엘, 타이어맨이 뭐라고 하나요?: It seems more threatening now... Daniel, what is it saying?
strings.영감 놓고 꺼져무!: 'Leave the inspiration and get lost, squawk!'
strings.놀이기구가 귀여운 얼굴을 하고 저런 나쁜 말을 쓰다니, 용서할 수 없습니: A piece of playground equipment with such a cute face using such foul language! Unforgivable!
strings.다니엘이 어떻게 하려고요?: What are you going to do, Daniel?
strings.%s 님, 당장 저 타이어맨을 혼내 주십쇼무!: %s, teach that Tire Man a lesson right now!
strings.(타이어맨이 팔을 흔들자, 주위에서 거센 바람이 몰아친다.): (As Tire Man waves its arms, fierce winds sweep through the area.)
strings.시끄러운 앵무새야, 프레이오스보다 더 위로 날아가 버려무?: 'You noisy parrot! Fly even higher than Freios, squawk!'
strings.저 날아가 버리는 겁니까무?: Am I about to be blown away?
strings.으갸악, 나 날아간담! 나 하늘 못 난다무우우우우우우우…………………………: Squaaawk! I'm flying away! I can't flyyyyy...
He flew so far he looks like a star in the sky...
What are you saying? Don't tell me...
I think it's saying, 'Get lost already!'
strings.(타이어맨의 포효가 허공해까지 가득 채울 정도로 크게 울려 퍼진다.): (Tire Man's roar echoes so loudly it seems to fill the Sea of Emptiness.)
strings.하아, 타이어맨. 저대로 두면 안 되기도 하지만, 저 뀨우 소리가 귀에: Sigh, Tire Man. I can't leave you like this anyway, but that squeaking is getting on my nerves.
strings.좋아, 타이어맨. 바람 빠질 각오나 하라고!!: All right, Tire Man. Prepare to have the wind knocked out of you!!
strings.(타이어맨이 %s의 공격에 뒤로 밀려난다.): (Tire Man is driven back by %s's attack.)
It doesn't look anywhere close to falling.
I pulled out the flag on Tire Man's head, and now it's losing air, squawk.
strings.(바람이 빠지기 시작하자 당황했는지 타이어맨이 정신을 차리지 못한다.): (As the air begins escaping, Tire Man panics and loses its composure.)
strings.후후, 바람이 이렇게 쉽게 빠지는 걸 보니 넌 타이어맨도 아니고 튜브맨이: Hehe. If you lose air this easily, you're not Tire Man. You're Inner Tube Man!
strings.(타이어맨이 필사적으로 팔로 구멍을 막아 보지만 역부족이다.): (Tire Man desperately tries to cover the hole with its arms, but cannot stop the leak.)
strings.%s 님, 마무리! 마무리하시면 됩니담! 저 말고, 타이어맨입니다무!: %s, finish it! Finish it off! Tire Man, not me, squawk!
strings.(다니엘의 말에 모험가가 힘을 모아 타이어맨에게 일격을 날린다.): (At Daniel's words, the adventurer gathers strength and strikes Tire Man.)
strings.우와, %s 님. 최고십니담. 커다랗기만 한 바보 녀석을 폐타이어로 만들: Wow, %s! You're the best. You turned that oversized fool back into scrap tires!
strings.역시 타이어맨도 비슷한 종류인가 봅니담. 뀨우우웅…하고 영감의 구슬을 떨: Tire Man must be the same kind as the others. It went 'squeee' and dropped an inspiration marble.
The marble is stuck to your body too, Daniel, so we're finished.
But how did you get back? The wind blew you away.
I flapped my way back, squawk.
strings.아까 못 난다고 하지 않았어요?: Didn't you say you couldn't fly?
strings.앵무 일족이 날아다닌 적이 없어서 저도 날 수 있다는 생각을 하지 못했습: The parrot clan has never flown, so I never thought I could either.
strings.팔이 좀 저립니다무. 으갸악. 건들지 마십쇼! 쥐 났습니담!! 으갸가아아: My arms are a little numb. Squaaawk! Don't touch them! I've got a cramp!! Squaaaaawk!
Then let me have exclusive rights to write articles about you, %s...
I'm joking. We'll do it later, though. I promise.
strings.와아아, 약속하신 겁니다무! 무르면 여신님에게 혼납니담! 으갸악, 또 손: Yay! You promised, squawk! The goddess will scold you if you take it back! Squaaawk, did you touch my arm again?!
strings.클라라 작가님, 영감이 돌아왔습니다무!: Author Clara, your inspiration is back!
strings.(다니엘이 클라라 앞에서 온몸을 흔들어 영감의 구슬을 털어 낸다.): (Daniel shakes his whole body in front of Clara, dislodging the inspiration marbles.)
strings.(반짝거리는 구슬이 클라라의 손이 닿을 때마다 맑고 고운 소리를 내며 사: (Each time Clara touches a sparkling marble, it vanishes with a clear, lovely sound.)
strings.집 나간 자식이 돌아온 기분이야. 내가 가출했을 때 엄마가 이런 기분이었: It feels like a child who ran away has come home. Did Mom feel this way when I ran away?
strings.엄마는 이해해 주셨을 겁니다무! 그래서, 그래서 다음은 어떻게 됩니까무?: I'm sure your mother understood! So, so, what happens next?!
That would be a spoiler. I'm not telling.
strings.작가님, 이건 맛있는 음식을 줬다가 뺏는 것보다 더합니다무! 저보다 나쁜: Author, that's worse than giving me delicious food and taking it away! Only demons worse than me would...
strings.다니엘, 기사가 올라간 잡지나 신문을 그냥 달라고 하면 줄 거야? 제대로: Daniel, if someone asked for a magazine or newspaper carrying your article for free, would you give it to them? Shouldn't they pay properly? You said you live on dirt...
Sob, sob. I don't want to eat dirt... I want delicious food...
Daniel, you aren't a bad demon.
strings.아차, 마족. 저 마족 아닙니다. 말하는 앵무 수인입니다. 님 말 잘 따: Oh, demon. I'm not a demon. I'm a talking parrot beastfolk. I'm good at repeating what you say.
You're denying it now...? Never mind.
You found all my inspiration. I think I can write without trouble now.
strings.속고만 살았어?: Have you spent your whole life being deceived?
...Yes. In the Demon Realm, I was always being deceived. There were job scams too...
Here, everyone tries to look after me. I'm bewildered.
strings.세상에는 나쁜 사람들도 있지만, 착한 사람들도 있어…. 그래서 인터뷰 할: There are bad people in the world, but good people too... So, do you want the interview or not?
strings.작가님, 이제 인터뷰해도 되겠습니까무?: Author, may I begin the interview now?
strings.그러면 두 분 인터뷰할 동안 저는 사서님들에게 놀이터 일 해결됐다고 말씀: While you two do the interview, I'll tell the librarians the playground problem is resolved.
strings.우왕! 인터뷰담, 인터뷰! 무! 무! 작가님, 이제 질문 드리겠습니다무!: Yay! An interview! Squawk, squawk! Author, I'll begin the questions now!
strings.클라라라는 소녀는 언제부터 글쓰기에 소질이 있었습니까? 그리고 언제 처음: When did the girl called Clara first show a talent for writing? And when did you first want to publish a book? And...
When was that...? Around four or five years old? Since then...
I'm glad Clara recovered all her inspiration...
We kept calling for inspiration, and the old Hermits gathered around. That was a problem.
strings.나중에 이런 일이 또 일어날 수도 있나요?: Could something like this happen again?
I can't guarantee anything, but the possibility isn't zero.
strings.클라라 작가님 말고도 영감이 가득한 분들이 더 있겠지만, 이런 일이 일어: There must be other people besides Clara full of inspiration. We'll watch more carefully to keep this from happening...
If you need my help, contact me again.
This isn't much, but please accept this small payment in Ely.
strings.그냥 돌아가시면 관장님께 저희가 혼납니다. 안 그래도 바쁜 분 불렀다면서: If you leave without it, the director will scold us for calling someone who was already busy.
...Liz, I don't want to be scolded...
Pull yourself together, Pel. Honestly, I don't want to be scolded either...
strings.(두 사람은 관장님에게 어떻게 혼이 난다는 거지?): (How exactly does the director scold these two?)
The interview is taking longer than expected.
strings.바쁘시면 먼저 돌아가셔도 됩니다. 클라라 작가님께 전할 말씀이 있으시면: If you're busy, you can head back first. If you have a message for Clara, we'll pass it on.
We have something to tell her too.
strings.그래요? 딱히 전할 말은 없고. 아, 원고 잘 완성되길 바란다고 전해 주: Really? I don't have much to say. Oh, tell her I hope the manuscript goes well. And that I'll see her later.
strings.사서님, 전에 내가 쓰던 방 비었어?: Librarian, is the room I used before vacant?
Daniel has given me some good material, so we'll have a canned writing retreat together...
strings.통조림, 통조림! 무슨 음식입니까무? (반짝반짝): Canned? Canned! What kind of food is it, squawk? (Eyes sparkle.)
Oh, I don't think that's what a writer means by 'canned'...
strings.원고가 완성될 때까지 밖으로 나오지 않는, 혹은 나오지 못하는 걸 통조림: It means staying inside, or being unable to leave, until the manuscript is finished...
strings.저도 같이 통조림입니까무?: Am I getting canned too, squawk?
strings.몬스터언어능력평가 2급이라 날뛰는 타이어맨과 말도 통하고, 기사 쓰는 거: You have MLPT level two, so you could talk with the rampaging Tire Man. And from your article, you seem talented... Want to work for me?
strings.대단해. 그러면 놀이터 일 해결에 도움이 됐겠네. 나중에 우리 일도 부탁: Impressive. That must have helped resolve the playground incident. Help us with our work sometime too.
Hmm... I'm a reporter, squawk... I only like canned things when I can eat them...
I'll provide room, board, snacks, and a salary...
strings.(클라라가 다니엘의 귀에 급여 액수를 속삭인다.): (Clara whispers the amount of the salary into Daniel's ear.)
strings.…그 정도면 특종 안 구해도 먹고살 수 있을 것 같습니다무!: ...At that rate, I could make a living without hunting scoops!
strings.그래도 나중에 특종 기사 쓸 수 있게 도와주셔야 합니담!: But you must help me write exclusive articles later too!
strings.사서님, 그때처럼 부탁해도 될까?: Librarian, could I ask for the same arrangement as before?
strings.(결국 다니엘은 통조림 노래를 부르며 클라라와 함께 작업실로 들어간다.): (In the end, Daniel enters the workroom with Clara, singing about canned food.)
strings.(나중에 들은 이야기지만, 신작이 완성되고서 한참 후에야 도서관 밖으로: (You later hear that he could not leave the library until long after the new book was finished.)
Sob, sob. I've been deceived again, squawk...
